condition_semantics.balanced: target_count distinct targets when regimes permits; fixed Bernoulli rate
condition_semantics.joint_target_and_rate_shift: target and rate both change each regime; diagnostic only
condition_semantics.rate_shift_fixed_target: target channel 0 stays correlated while source rate alternates and independent background channels remain at balanced_rate

config.rate_shift_semantics: controlled stress condition alternates only source rate while independent background targets stay at balanced_rate and the correlated target copies source; a separate joint condition changes source, background rate, and target identity together

hypothesis_thresholds_scope: registered quantitative prediction is for N=8 and eight regimes; other N values are exploratory extensions
hypothesis_title: Coactivity-gated probationary sprouting under a hard synaptic budget

prediction_definitions.null_contacts: mean mature-contact count per timestep on an independent-target stream
prediction_definitions.online_mse: mean squared error over all eight target event probabilities before observe
prediction_definitions.recovery: first within-regime step of a 50-sample consecutive run with target as mature contact
prediction_definitions.target_coverage: fraction of correlated-stream samples where the hidden target is a mature contact
prediction_definitions.target_mse: MSE on the regime's hidden correlated target channel, omitted for null streams
